title: Sakina ko chod de
body:
naize pe sar hussain ka ye keh ke ro pada
zaalim meri yateem sakina ko chod de
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun maarta hai isne bigada hai kya tera
zaalim meri yateem sakina ko chod de
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle hi ghamzada ne sahe hai bade sitam
bichda hai kamsini mein pidar kam hai kya ye gham
behre khuda ghamon ki satayi ko na sata
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghamzada ko baap ka pursa na de layeen
deta nahi gar isko dilaasa na de layeen
lillaah iske rukh pe tamache to na laga
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dushmani layeen teri gar hussain se
tu taziyane mere kate sar pe maar le
durre na maar isko hai masoom bekhata
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
behaal ho chuki hai ye shiddat se pyaas ki
durron ka waar sehne ki quwwat nahi bachi
eeza na de ab aur isay behre kibriya
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai jab se baap ka kat'ta hua gala
darr yun basa hai dil mein larazti hai ghamzada
mar jayegi sehem ke isay aur na dara
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
naazuk hai kaan cheen na bunde yun khaynch ke
beti hai ye kareem ki de degi maang le
tadpa ke is yateem ko kya haath aayega
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
eeza na de behen ko baradar ke saamne
kode na maar abid e laaghar ke saamne
ghairat pe ek bhai ki ye zakhm na laga
zaalim meri yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho kya bayan nadeem wo ghurbat wo bekasi
mehsoos qaid e shaam mein hota hai aaj bhi
jaise ki de raha ho tadap kar koi sada
zaalim meri yateem...
author: Nadeem Sultanpuri
